property_summary: The depositsCount variable must equal the total number of successful receive calls (i.e., exactly +1 per call). The bug increments depositsCount by 2 per call, so after any receive call, depositsCount becomes greater than the number of calls made, violating the one-to-one invariant.
change_summary: Replace the increment with a larger increment (e.g., +2), breaking the expected one-to-one deposit counter.
